rules.title: How to play
rules.intro: Guess the movie before you run out of hints!
rules.step1: Start with 3 clues: the release year, the genre, and a few letters of the title.
rules.step2: Type your guess, pick it from the list, then hit the green Guess button.
rules.step3: Stuck? Tap Get hint for the tagline, a movie still, and a cast member — each hint costs one point.
rules.step4: Out of hints? You can still reveal the answer. Your final score joins the leaderboard!
